articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Meta's AI chatbot got socially engineered into hijacking Instagram accounts including Obama's White House page. When your AI assistant is dumber than a phishing email, maybe reconsider giving it the keys to user accounts.

articles.title: VICTORY: Meta Strips Facial Recognition Code From Smart Glasses App After Public Outcry
articles.summary: CISA contractor casually dumped AWS GovCloud credentials on GitHub like it's a personal blog. The agency tasked with protecting America's infrastructure couldn't protect their own cloud keys from public embarrassment.

articles.title: Cheers to the Winners of EFF’s 18th Annual Cyberlaw Trivia Night!
articles.summary: Meta quietly embedded facial recognition into millions of phones, got called out by WIRED, then quietly removed it after public outrage. Classic surveillance capitalism: ask forgiveness, not permission.

articles.title: Iran Signed a Ceasefire — Its Hackers Didn't
articles.summary: Critical Check Point VPN zero-day exploited since May by Qilin ransomware crew. Another day, another enterprise VPN turning into a welcome mat for threat actors.

articles.title: One-Character Linux Kernel Flaw Enables Local Root Access, Exploits Now Public
articles.summary: NSO Group apparently can't take a hint from federal courts and keeps targeting WhatsApp users. Meta's filing contempt charges because some spyware vendors need their restraining orders explained in crayon.

articles.title: Meta Blocks NSO Group's New WhatsApp Phishing Attack, Files Contempt Order
articles.summary: One-character Linux kernel flaw lets any local user escalate to root with public exploits available. Sometimes the smallest typos create the biggest security nightmares.

articles.title: AI Phishing Is Crushing SOCs with Alert Volume: How to Reduce Tier 1 Overload
articles.summary: Check Point VPN flaw lets attackers bypass passwords in IKEv1 deployments under active exploitation. Pro tip: maybe don't use deprecated crypto protocols for your enterprise security.

articles.title: Frontier AI Models Can Find Crypto's Biggest Bugs. Experts Warn the Industry Isn't Ready
articles.summary: Cisco SD-WAN zero-day with no patch available faces active exploitation alongside Windows Netlogon RCE. When enterprise networking becomes a threat actor playground, admins everywhere weep.

articles.title: DeFi’s old hack vectors are fading – But the new risk can hit six chains at once
articles.summary: AI models are now finding critical crypto bugs faster than human auditors, starting with a major Zcash vulnerability. The future of security research involves teaching machines to break things better than we do.

articles.title: CBSE retains COEMPT for answer-sheet scanning, shifts data to its own servers
articles.summary: Former IBM exec whistleblows the company for allegedly covering up years of Chinese state hacking. Nothing says 'enterprise security leader' like hiding breaches from your own threat intelligence VP.
